description: List up to 50 changes waiting for an organizer's approval in this event's Coordinator inbox, newest first. Use it to follow up on a write that returned pending_approval. Returns approvals[] with toolName, summary, status, createdAt, and a link to the approval inbox, plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: list_pending_approvals

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
